runs.final_sql: SELECT d.frnm, d.srnm FROM drvr d JOIN lp_tm l ON d.drvr_id = l.ref1 WHERE d.ntnl = 'Spanish' AND YEAR(d.db) < 1982 GROUP BY d.drvr_id, d.frnm, d.srnm ORDER BY MAX(l.mlls) DESC LIMIT 10
